eligibility.approver_variant: same eligibility, restricted to PRs with at least one distinct APPROVED human reviewer
eligibility.reviewer_primary: non-bot author, at least one distinct human reviewer, and at least one integration module
eligibility.secondary: non-bot author, at least one distinct human reviewer, any touched module type

methods.B1: current declared Person owners of touched integrations; rank by owned integration count, then pre-merge global review count
methods.B3: pre-merge exponentially decayed REVIEWED edge count
methods.G1: sum over touched non-infra modules of unit module weight times role-weighted, merge-time-decayed prior PR expertise divided by each prior PR's touched-module count
methods.G2: G1 plus neighbor_factor times DEPENDS_ON neighbor expertise for touched integrations with fewer than five prior PRs
methods.broad_pr_downweight: Each prior PR contribution is divided by its number of TOUCHES edges across all module kinds.
methods.tie_break: global popularity before login order; B1 first ranks by owner count.

oracle_definition: Fraction with at least one true reviewer who had a REVIEWED edge on a prior PR before the target merge time.
static_relationship_caveat: DECLARED_OWNER and DEPENDS_ON have no valid-from history in this graph; B1 and G2 use current manifest/source snapshots, so post-target relationship changes cannot be ruled out.

tuning.objective: validation primary hit@3, ties by MRR then recall@5

window.rule: All history queries filter merged_ts < the target PR merge time.
